svg.title: Bohemia: from public request to reported interagency arrangement, June 2023 through January 2024
svg.desc: Four chronological cards distinguish the June 2023 proposal to release a reported 800,000-dollar interagency balance, July debate over the use of public mineral royalties, December executive-director report of a renegotiated memorandum and released 2006–2007 balance, and the subsequently described January 2024 management effective date. A director's report is not the executed agreement or proof of heir restitution.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios, November 17, 2026. Copyright (c) 2026 Final Vestige Studios; original first-party vector illustration; all rights reserved. This is an explanatory diagram, not a historical photograph or reconstruction. Sources: 1. Flood Protection Authority-East, Board Minutes, June 15 2023, https://www.floodauthority.org/ ; 2. Lakefront Management Authority, Board Minutes, July 27 2023, https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/July-27-2023-FULL-BOARD-Minutes-Approved-SEPT2023.pdf ; 3. Lakefront Management Authority, Board Minutes, December 14 2023, printed p. 7, https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/DEC-14-2023-Board-Meeting-Minutes__SCORED-AND-APPROVED-1.25.2024.pdf ; 4. Lakefront Management Authority, Commercial Real Estate Committee Minutes, July 25 2024, pp. 4-5, https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/25-JULY-2024-Commercial-Real-estate-Committee-Minutes_Approved-9.19.2024.pdf . Caption: The record evolved from requests about Bohemia's public mineral income to a director's account of a negotiated interagency change. The signed memorandum, its exact debt terms, private claimant payments and individual royalty receipts were not independently inspected. Alt text: Four dated cards: June 2023 requested interagency relief and a new royalty use; July 2023 officials discussed dedication; December 2023 the LMA director reported a revised MOU and released old balance; January 2024 was the subsequently reported start of LMA management.
svg.text: balance and a future royalty use.
What is missing: the executed MOU and ledgers.
None of these is an individual heir-payment record.
Source credits and limitations: embedded SVG metadata.
